about.en: Super Inu (SI) is a dog-themed meme token launched through the StonkFun launchpad as a Solana Token-2022 mint at DEW9dSN6QpWyNthphCpMmAbZP1Q4cEKR9xQXAri98WDP, where it trades against NVIDIA xStock (NVDAx). The mint charges a 1% transfer fee. It has no issuer backing and no project website beyond its StonkFun page.
